scope: Selected passing local ARM64 diagnostic, not maximum capacity or an official k6/droplet score

environment.server_os: Ubuntu 24.04 ARM64 Docker VM on Apple M2 Pro

method.request_mix: bench/load.js feed/post/like/create user loop, probabilities and think-time ranges
method.differences_from_k6: Different PRNG/post text; no separate warm-up or ramp-down; hold-only latency thresholds
method.percentiles: Maximum of the shard percentiles; not pooled percentiles
method.memory: Process RSS/HWM summed over parent and descendants; shared pages may be counted more than once. Container memory includes helper, page cache and kernel; sampled every approximately two seconds
method.time_policy: Fresh process and database, one case at a time
